import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  Grid,
  Button,
  Typography,
  TextField,
  MenuItem,
  Select,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
  Card,
  CardMedia,
} from "@mui/material";
import "./App.css";
import {
  binaryRequest,
  grayScaleRequest,
  cropImageRequest,
  rotateRequest,
  zoomInRequest,
  brightnessRequest,
  gaussRequest,
  blurringRequest,
  adaptifEsiklemeRequest,
  gurultuEklemeRequest,
  gurultuTemizlemeRequest,
  edgeDetectionRequest,
  histogramStretchRequest,
  arithmeticOperationsRequest,
  morphologyRequest,
  motionBlurRequest,
  colorSpaceConversionRequest,
  convolutionRequest,
  contrastReductionRequest,
  doubleThresholdRequest,
} from "./requests/requests";
import { useFilePicker } from "use-file-picker";

function App() {
  const [data, setData] = useState({
    cropX: 2,
    cropY: 2,
    cropA: 200,
    cropB: 200,
    rotateValue: 90,
    zoomInValue: 2,
    zoomInCenterX: 450,
    zoomInCenterY: 450,
    brightnessFactor: 1.5,
    blur_kernel_size: 10,
    gauss_kernel_size: 10,
    gauss_sigma: 5,
    adaptifBlockSize: 15,
    adaptifCValue: 10,
    saltValue: 0.1,
    pepperValue: 0.1,
    gurultuFilterSize: 3,
    gurultuFilterType: "mean",
    morphologyType: "dilate",
    arithmeticType: "subtract",
    colorType: "RGB",
  });

  const [output, setOutput] = useState();
  const { openFilePicker, filesContent, plainFiles, clear } = useFilePicker({
    readAs: "DataURL",
    accept: "image/*",
    multiple: false,
  });

  const changeHandler = (e) => {
    setData({ ...data, [e.target.name]: e.target.value });
  };

  async function applyOperation(requestFunc, extraData = {}) {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("file", plainFiles[0]);
    Object.entries(extraData).forEach(([key, val]) => formData.append(key, val));
    const imageUrl = await requestFunc(formData);
    if (imageUrl) setOutput(imageUrl);
  }

  return (
    <Grid container direction="column" alignItems="center">
      <Typography variant="h4" my={2}>Görüntü İşleme Uygulaması</Typography>

      <Grid item>
        <Button variant="contained" color="error" onClick={clear}>Temizle</Button>
        <Button variant="contained" color="primary" onClick={openFilePicker} sx={{ mx: 1 }}>
          Resim Yükle
        </Button>
      </Grid>

      <Grid item container spacing={2} justifyContent="center" my={2}>
        <Grid item>
          {filesContent.length > 0 && (
            <Card><CardMedia component="img" height="200" image={filesContent[0].content} /></Card>
          )}
        </Grid>
        <Grid item>
          {output ? <Card><CardMedia component="img" height="200" image={output} /></Card> : null}
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      <Grid container spacing={2} justifyContent="center">
        <Grid item>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(grayScaleRequest)}>Grayscale</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(binaryRequest)}>Binary</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(cropImageRequest, {
            x: data.cropX, y: data.cropY, a: data.cropA, b: data.cropB
          })}>Crop</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(rotateRequest, { x: data.rotateValue })}>Rotate</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(zoomInRequest, {
            zoom_factor: data.zoomInValue,
            center_x: data.zoomInCenterX,
            center_y: data.zoomInCenterY
          })}>Zoom</Button>
        </Grid>

        <Grid item>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(brightnessRequest, { x: data.brightnessFactor })}>Brightness</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(gaussRequest, { x: data.gauss_kernel_size, y: data.gauss_sigma })}>Gaussian</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(blurringRequest, { x: data.blur_kernel_size })}>Blurring</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(adaptifEsiklemeRequest, { x: data.adaptifBlockSize, y: data.adaptifCValue })}>Adaptive Threshold</Button>
        </Grid>

        <Grid item>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(gurultuEklemeRequest, { x: data.saltValue, y: data.pepperValue })}>Salt & Pepper</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(gurultuTemizlemeRequest, { x: data.gurultuFilterType, y: data.gurultuFilterSize })}>Noise Filter</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(edgeDetectionRequest)}>Canny Edge</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(histogramStretchRequest)}>Histogram Stretch</Button>
        </Grid>

        <Grid item>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(arithmeticOperationsRequest, { op: data.arithmeticType })}>Arithmetic</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(morphologyRequest, { op: data.morphologyType })}>Morphology</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(motionBlurRequest)}>Motion Blur</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(colorSpaceConversionRequest, { space: data.colorType })}>Color Convert</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(convolutionRequest)}>Convolution</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(contrastReductionRequest)}>Contrast</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => applyOperation(doubleThresholdRequest)}>Double Threshold</Button>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      <Grid item container spacing={2} justifyContent="center" my={2}>
        <TextField label="Rotate" name="rotateValue" value={data.rotateValue} onChange={changeHandler} />
        <TextField label="Brightness" name="brightnessFactor" value={data.brightnessFactor} onChange={changeHandler} />
        <FormControl>
          <InputLabel>Color Space</InputLabel>
          <Select name="colorType" value={data.colorType} onChange={changeHandler}>
            <MenuItem value="RGB">RGB</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="HSV">HSV</MenuItem>
          </Select>
        </FormControl>
        <FormControl>
          <InputLabel>Morphology</InputLabel>
          <Select name="morphologyType" value={data.morphologyType} onChange={changeHandler}>
            <MenuItem value="dilate">Dilate</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="erode">Erode</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="open">Open</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="close">Close</MenuItem>
          </Select>
        </FormControl>
      </Grid>
    </Grid>
  );
}

export default App;
